parameters.query:
with candidate as materialized (
  select
    ci.content_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.category,
    ci.status,
    ci.source_payload_json,
    s.selected_hook,
    s.narration_script,
    s.cta_line,
    p.caption_final,
    p.hashtags_final,
    coalesce(sb.cover_prompt, '') as cover_prompt,
    coalesce(sb.style_notes, '') as style_notes
  from content_items ci
  join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
  join publishes p on p.content_id = ci.content_id
  left join storyboards sb on sb.content_id = ci.content_id
  where ci.status in ('storyboard_complete', 'approval_rejected', 'qa_approved')
    and p.platform = 'instagram'
    and p.publish_status in ('draft', 'failed')
    and p.published_at is null
    and coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.instagram_media_id), ''), '') = ''
  order by ci.updated_at asc
  limit 1
), claim as (
  update content_items ci
  set status = 'generating_assets',
      updated_at = now()
  where ci.content_id = (select content_id from candidate)
    and ci.status in ('storyboard_complete', 'approval_rejected', 'qa_approved')
  returning ci.content_id
)
select
  c.content_id,
  c.title,
  c.category,
  c.status,
  c.source_payload_json,
  c.selected_hook,
  c.narration_script,
  c.cta_line,
  c.caption_final,
  c.hashtags_final,
  c.cover_prompt,
  c.style_notes
from candidate c
join claim cl on cl.content_id = c.content_id;

delete from assets
where content_id = '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid
  and asset_role = '{{$json.asset_role_sql}}';

insert into assets (
  content_id,
  scene_number,
  asset_role,
  provider,
  source_url,
  storage_url,
  mime_type,
  width,
  height,
  status,
  metadata_json
)
values (
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
  null,
  '{{$json.asset_role_sql}}',
  '{{$json.provider_sql}}',
  '{{$json.source_url_sql}}',
  '{{$json.storage_url_sql}}',
  '{{$json.mime_type_sql}}',
  {{$json.width}},
  {{$json.height}},
  '{{$json.status_sql}}',
  '{{$json.asset_metadata_json_sql}}'::jsonb
)
returning content_id, asset_role, storage_url, mime_type, provider, status;

update content_items
set status = 'approval_pending',
    approved_at = null,
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Asset SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, title, status, approved_at, updated_at;

update scripts
set approved_by_human = false,
    generated_at = generated_at
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Asset SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, approved_by_human;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Asset SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Asset SQL Values"].json["workflow_name_sql"]}}',
  'success',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Post Asset Payload"].json["run_started_at"]}}'::timestamptz,
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Asset SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  null,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'generation_model', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Asset SQL Values"].json["generation_model_sql"]}}', ''),
    'asset_validation_note', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Asset SQL Values"].json["asset_validation_note_sql"]}}', ''),
    'asset', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Asset SQL Values"].json["asset_metadata_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
